scope.purpose: Finish the ordinary local Hypervisor test environment with one fixed freestanding arithmetic guest per explicit development run.
native_owns: stable snapshot and volatile pre-teardown commitment
scope.ordinary_repeat_rule: A later explicit development run may use a new UUID after the prior native resources are conserved; it is not a retry or reopening of any historical one-shot authority. Unresolved native teardown permanently blocks another run in that app process.
scope.entry_surface: Explicit Run button, or the exact Debug-only --run-fixed-guest-once automation flag. The flag selects this same fixed operation once and accepts no guest path, arguments, environment, address, timeout or role. Release does not admit the flag. No other startup path runs a guest automatically.

host_admission.signature: Existing Apple Development signing and actual-process admission; exact bundle and Team, Hardened Runtime, and only the three true entitlements below.
host_admission.capability: The signed app displays advisory Hypervisor capability observations. The actual fixed hv_vm_create call is the operational support admission and any failure rejects execution. Capability-query success alone is not guest execution evidence.
host_admission.source_and_image_identity: Before the first run, retain the reviewed source checkpoint, signed host image identity, exact embedded guest bytes and SHA-256, and the inspected doorbell instruction offset. This contract contains no digest of itself and is not a generated PASS receipt.

image_and_memory.image_kind: One fixed flat freestanding AArch64 image embedded in the signed host; no path loader, runtime compiler, plugin or guest executable parser.
image_and_memory.image_pin_basis: Separately assembled __TEXT,__text bytes were compared to all 23 embedded little-endian instruction words; the Mach-O container is not the guest image. The independent pure-test fixture must match this same byte hash.
image_and_memory.host_backing_note: Three 32768-byte anonymous host allocations provide aligned 16384-byte guest slots; only the three declared slots are guest-mapped.

mappings.initial_content: exact embedded image followed by zeros

initial_machine_state.readback: Before entry require exact SCTLR_EL1 and CPSR; after an entered run separately read PC and X4. Retain call counts, last raw status and first failure; this is not a per-register raw-call trace. No inherited register value is an input to the arithmetic.

fixed_frames.encoding: Four consecutive unsigned 64-bit little-endian words; no padding, host pointer, string or optional field.
fixed_frames.mathematical_reference: 19 + 23 = 42, exactly within UInt64; no floating-point or model inference.
fixed_frames.completion_order: Guest stores the complete reply, performs the frozen release/barrier sequence including DSB, then attempts the one 32-bit doorbell store.

execution_and_exit.owner: One dedicated OS thread owns VM creation, mapping, vCPU creation, register setup/readback, run, vCPU destruction, unmapping and VM destruction. A Swift actor or serial queue alone is not an OS-thread-identity guarantee.

expected_exit.kind: Hypervisor exception caused by the deliberate unmapped doorbell store
expected_exit.syndrome_complete_match: 0x93840040 | DFSC, with DFSC in 4...7 (translation-fault level 0...3); no other bits may vary.
expected_exit.pc: 0x10000050: code base plus doorbell instruction offset 80, checked against the separately inspected 92-byte embedded image; no PC advance.

execution_and_exit.exit_limit: The trapped store is an intercepted access attempt, not a completed MMIO write. Matching reply bytes alone do not establish the required exit.
execution_and_exit.acceptance: Execution requires one successful run return, the exact expected trap and machine observations, unchanged complete code/request pages, exact reply prefix and zero reply tail, and a valid stable snapshot seal. Teardown and durable persistence are separately evaluated.

watchdog_and_conservation.thread_lifetime: One sleeping condition-variable watchdog is created only during an explicit guest run and joined before native return. No watchdog or vCPU remains on an ordinary completed run.
watchdog_and_conservation.watchdog_action: Request hv_vcpus_exit for only the active owned vCPU; never signal a host process.
watchdog_and_conservation.user_cancel: epr_guest_cancel may compete with the watchdog for that same at-most-one cancellation request. Acceptance is not proof of vCPU exit or teardown.
watchdog_and_conservation.identity_lifetime: Protect the active vCPU identity and cancellation/destruction handoff under a native lock; run must not hold that lock while preventing watchdog progress. Join the watchdog before retiring its shared state.
watchdog_and_conservation.release_rule: Never free or reuse backing guest memory while execution or mappings may remain live. Require observed exit when entered and successful applicable destruction/unmapping before release.
watchdog_and_conservation.failed_teardown: Retain/quarantine unresolved resources and permanently reject further guest runs in that app process; no inferred cleanup, automatic retry, manual process signal or success relabeling.
watchdog_and_conservation.not_entered_status_sentinel: INT32_MIN for a native API call whose entry did not occur; zero must not stand in for not-entered.

snapshot_commitment.algorithm: Existing MerkleGenesis SHA-256 framing, independently implemented in native C and Swift.

leaves_in_utf8_lexical_order.label: guest_image
leaves_in_utf8_lexical_order.payload: exact unpadded embedded guest image bytes

leaves_in_utf8_lexical_order.label: schema
leaves_in_utf8_lexical_order.payload: exact schema UTF-8 bytes with no terminating NUL or line feed

snapshot_commitment.leaf_frame: 0x00 || UInt32BE(label byte count) || label UTF-8 || UInt64BE(payload byte count) || payload
snapshot_commitment.binary_node_frame: 0x01 || left SHA256 bytes || right SHA256 bytes
snapshot_commitment.pre_teardown: After the sole vCPU exit, with all guest and host writers quiescent, C copies and validates the bounded snapshot, computes the volatile four-leaf root and records snapshot_ticks before teardown.
snapshot_commitment.post_teardown: After the native call returns, Swift independently reconstructs the root from copied values and the exact embedded image, then persists the observation and terminal. Swift does not read live guest memory.
snapshot_commitment.crash_limit: A crash between volatile sealing and SQLite persistence can leave only the committed start; it remains incomplete. Neither hashing nor a Merkle root proves hardware attestation or durable publication.
snapshot_commitment.other_evidence: Raw exit/API statuses, complete-page validation results and clock fields are retained in the journal observation; they are not secretly included in this four-leaf root.

journal.owner: Swift host only, one serialized writer
journal.location_rule: Inside this application's sandbox container, permanently disjoint from historical PrivateCompute receipts, old guardian epochs, source trees and temporary build roots; validate actual model path before execution.
journal.run_id: Fresh UUID for each explicit ordinary development run; no automatic rerun or reuse of a historical one-shot identifier.
journal.parent_encoding: Empty byte string for sequence zero; otherwise the prior event's 32-byte SHA-256.
journal.digest: SHA-256 of the complete deterministic CBOR event; digest stored outside its own hashed event payload.
journal.encoding: RFC 8949 section 4.2.1 core deterministic CBOR for the admitted unsigned-integer, UTF-8 text, byte-string, array, text-keyed-map and Boolean types; shortest/definite encoding, encoded-key lexical ordering, duplicate/unknown representation and trailing-byte rejection.
journal.native_status_encoding: The native_status_decimal map stores every native Int32 status as lossless canonical signed decimal TEXT. INT32_MIN is the exact text -2147483648; zero is the exact text 0, not a substitute for absent entry. No leading plus/zero aliases, clamping or unsigned reinterpretation. Hardware ticks and flags remain unsigned CBOR integers.
lifecycle: Commit and read back start containing exact host/guest/configuration identity, request and clock metadata before native entry.
Run the fixed native operation once on its dedicated owner thread.
After return independently verify the volatile snapshot root, retain copied image/request/reply and raw native statuses/ticks, and commit the observation.
Commit terminal referring to the observation and separately representing execution, teardown, reconstruction and persistence outcomes.
Read back the event chain, canonical bytes and indexed projection before displaying a durably retained terminal.
durability: CBOR bytes and indexed projection in the same SQLite transaction
journal.failure: Start-only is incomplete. A commit error can mean uncertain persistence; do not infer event absence or repeat guest entry. A guest PASS, conservation PASS and journal PASS are separate predicates.
journal.clock: Retain raw monotonic ticks and actual timebase numerator/denominator; use exact rational conversion. Journal event sequence is not elapsed time or a DeltaPU semantic-change clock.
journal.energy: Unmeasured unless a separately authorized actual energy source is captured; elapsed/CPU ticks do not establish ergs.

review_surfaces: native image, machine state, trap, cancellation and lifetime
signed app integration, exact contract and pure tests
build_inspection: ordinary signed macOS-14 arm64 app build
exact embedded guest bytes and disassembly
pure_tests: four-leaf Merkle framing and tamper rejection
CBOR event round-trip and ancestry fields
no filesystem, native VM, watchdog, process or guest entry in contract tests
runtime_success_predicates: complete code/request pages unchanged and reply tail zero
observation and terminal chain read back exactly
validation_before_first_run.excluded_incomplete_source: Sources/GuestStorage.swift remains excluded and must not be called.
validation_before_first_run.result_language: A passing run is local fixed guest transport, computation and persistence mechanics only; it does not establish DeltaPU acceleration, a macOS guest OS, Prime execution, candidate selection or Gate-E closure.
